briefing: NASDAQ +2.3% and S&P 500 +1.5% mark a strong risk-on day, so per prior lessons we deployed available cash into the two strongest multi-signal candidates, NN and QCOM, rather than holding idle. Existing positions are held unchanged since none triggered stop-loss or profit-target rules.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-on' day is when investors broadly favor growth and higher-risk assets like tech stocks, pushing indexes like the NASDAQ sharply higher. Strategy calls for deploying cash into high-conviction, multi-signal candidates during these moves rather than sitting on idle capital.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）行情是指投資者普遍傾向買入科技股等較高風險資產，帶動納指等指數大幅上升的日子。策略建議在這種時機將閒置現金投入具多重訊號確認的高信心標的，而非持續觀望。

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with the NASDAQ up 2.3% and S&P 500 up 1.5%, reflecting a risk-on shift in investor sentiment toward growth and tech names. Breadth was strong, with many momentum stocks showing bullish MACD crossovers and volume surges consistent with institutional buying. No single catalyst headline was provided today, so this move reflects broad-based risk appetite rather than one specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚，納指升2.3%，標普500升1.5%，反映投資者情緒轉向風險偏好，資金流向科技及增長股。市場廣度良好，多隻動能股出現MACD黃金交叉及成交量放大，顯示有機構資金進場。今日未有提供具體新聞標題作為觸發因素，故此次上升較大機會屬於整體風險偏好回升，而非單一事件驅動。

trades.reasoning: Highest-scoring candidate (100) with full signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge — on a strong risk-on day.
Second-highest score (95) with bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, and price above SMA-20, deploying remaining cash per risk-on cadence.
